name: yunlv-compliance-check
description: Use when user needs to check import/export compliance requirements for specific products and countries. Use when verifying product certifications, tariffs, sanctions, or regulatory requirements. Use when screening business partners against trade sanctions or embargo lists. Use when user mentions "合规检查", "进出口合规", "产品认证", "关税", "制裁名单", "禁运", "清关", "认证要求", "compliance", "import regulations".
